summary: Iteration 5 verifies (a) /brand.php?slug=microsoft|bitdefender|mcafee return 200 with correct H1 + product counts (30/6/1) + brand JSON-LD + products grid (verified visually on Microsoft brand page: H1='Microsoft Software', 30 product cards rendered), (b) nonexistent brand slug returns 404, (c) brand-articles-section-empty placeholder renders when seo_ai_blog_log is empty, (d) brand-articles-section + brand-article-<id> cards render after seeding 30 rows across MS/BD/MCA products, (e) product.php has data-testid=product-brand-link pointing to brand.php?slug=microsoft, (f) admin AI Auto-Blogger feed sub-text contains 'newest first · click any to view live', (g) pagination block (feed-pagination, feed-page-1, feed-page-2, feed-page-prev, feed-page-next) renders with exactly 25 rows on page 1 and the remaining rows on page 2 (?feed_page=2) when seo_ai_blog_log has 30 rows, (h) no seo-budget-alert or adm-budget-toast testids exist anywhere, (i) all 12 admin tabs return HTTP 200 with no PHP fatal/parse errors and always show adm-nav-seo in sidebar, (j) admin login works with the credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md, (k) robots.txt served from localhost:3000 has 41 user-agent directives including GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended/Applebot, (l) homepage still renders LocalBusiness + Brand JSON-LD. 28/29 pytest cases passed. 1 critical regression: /sitemap.xml is missing brand.php URLs because router.php (line 8) serves sitemap-xml.php which lacks the brand-emission loop — the brand loop in includes/seo_ai.php builds a different file that isn't served. Cleanup of 30 TEST_iter5_* seed rows verified (COUNT=0 after session).

critical.issue: Routed to sitemap-xml.php which does NOT emit /brand.php?slug=microsoft|bitdefender|mcafee entries. Spec requires 3 brand URLs in the sitemap. The brand-emission loop in includes/seo_ai.php lines 425-428 is correct but writes to a different file that the router does not serve.

action_items: FIX /app/php-version/sitemap-xml.php: append a loop over distinct products.brand to emit `/brand.php?slug=<slug>` entries (3 URLs: microsoft, bitdefender, mcafee). Example: `foreach (db()->query("SELECT DISTINCT brand FROM products WHERE brand <> '' AND " . active_regions_sql_in('region')) as $br) { $slug = strtolower(str_replace(' ', '-', (string)$br['brand'])); $urls[] = [$base . '/brand.php?slug=' . $slug, $today, 'weekly', '0.8']; }`. The same code already exists in includes/seo_ai.php :425-428 but is never invoked for the public sitemap because router.php routes /sitemap.xml to sitemap-xml.php.
critical_code_review_comments: Two sitemap implementations coexist: (1) seo_ai.php seo_ai_build_sitemap() that writes a static sitemap.xml AND (2) sitemap-xml.php that streams dynamically via router.php. Only #2 is reachable from the public URL — #1 is dead code as far as users / search engines are concerned. Consolidate to one source of truth to avoid future drift.

brand.php case-insensitive brand resolution uses LOWER(REPLACE(brand,' ','-')) on every request without an index. Acceptable for 3 brands today; add `KEY idx_brand_slug ((LOWER(REPLACE(brand,' ','-'))))` if brand count grows beyond ~20.

Admin feed pagination loops `for ($i = 1; $i <= $totalPages; $i++)` to emit ellipsis sentinels. With many pages this still O(totalPages) iterations; fine for blog log volume but worth noting if rows ever reach 10k+.

brand.php articles query LIMITs 50 — there is no pagination on the public brand page even though admin paginates at 25. If a brand accumulates >50 AI articles, the oldest ones become invisible from the brand profile.

rca_of_the_issue: router.php line 8 maps /sitemap.xml → sitemap-xml.php. sitemap-xml.php contains URL emission for static pages, categories, products, blog_posts, and content pages — but NO loop over distinct products.brand to emit /brand.php?slug=<slug>. Meanwhile, includes/seo_ai.php has the correct brand emission at lines 425-428 inside seo_ai_build_sitemap() which writes to /app/php-version/sitemap.xml — but that static file is never served because the router intercepts /sitemap.xml first. Reproduction: `curl -s https://side-showcase.preview.emergentagent.com/sitemap.xml | grep brand.php` → returns 0 matches. Fix: replicate the brand emission loop from seo_ai.php into sitemap-xml.php (preferred), OR remove the router intercept so the static sitemap.xml is served (riskier — stalls daily because nothing rebuilds it on schedule).
